Markets.com — Your Trading Platform

New 24/7 Trading Products Available

Discover trading opportunities with Markets.com. Our user-friendly platform helps you explore a wide range of trading products, including:

• 24/7 Trading Products: Gold, Silver, Platinum, Crude Oil
• 24/7 Stock CFDs: Tesla, AMD, NVIDIA, Micron, META
• Forex: EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/JPY, AUD/USD
• Commodities: Gold, Silver, Natural Gas, Crude Oil

Why Trade with Markets.com
 • Multiple payment methods, including Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay, and more
 • Spreads from 0.0 pips and zero commissions on selected instruments*
 • No Markets.com deposit or withdrawal fees*
 • Fast execution with no requotes under normal market conditions
 • Low minimum deposit
 • Multi-language app and popular platforms
 • Segregated client funds
 • Negative balance protection for eligible retail clients
*Spreads vary by market conditions and instrument. Third-party or other fees may apply.

Our Track Record
Markets.com has built a global presence by supporting traders with accessible platforms, market tools, educational resources, and dedicated customer support.
Over the years, the brand has continued to evolve its trading experience, broaden its product offering, and strengthen its technology and partner network.

Global Broker Serving Traders Since 2008
Since 2008, Markets.com has delivered advanced trading technology, charting tools, and customer support to traders worldwide.

Secure, Regulated Trading Environment
Markets.com operates under multiple regulated jurisdictions, including CySEC in Europe and FSCA in South Africa.
We support client confidence through segregated client funds, negative balance protection for retail clients where applicable, and strong regulatory compliance across jurisdictions.

Jurisdiction Information
Markets.com operates globally under the following jurisdictions:
• Europe: Safecap Investments Limited, regulated by CySEC under license no. 092/08.
• Africa: Markets South Africa (Pty) Ltd, regulated by FSCA under license no. 46860 and licensed as an Over-the-Counter Derivatives Provider.
• Markets International Limited, registered in Saint Vincent and the Grenadines under registration number 27030 BC 2023.

Risk Warning
Risk warning: Check our website for the percentage of retail investor accounts who lose money when trading CFDs with us. CFDs are complex instruments and carry a high risk of losing money rapidly due to leverage. You should consider whether you understand how CFDs work and whether you can afford to take the high risk of losing your money.
